hook.excerpt: Northern South America, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between French Guiana and Guyana || mostly rolling hills; narrow coastal plain with swamps || smallest independent country on the South American continent; mostly tropical rainforest; great diversity of flora and fauna; relatively small population, mostly along the coast || Resources: timber, hydropower, fish, kaolin, shrimp, bauxite, gold, and small amounts of nickel, copper, platinum, iron ore || Exports: gold, fish, refined petroleum, wood, tobacco (2023)

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income South American economy; new floating currency regime; key aluminum goods, gold, and hydrocarbon exporter; new IMF plan for economic recovery and fiscal sustainability; controversial hardwood industry || Exports: gold, fish, refined petroleum, wood, tobacco (2023) || Industries: gold mining, oil, lumber, food processing, fishing
